annotations.title: Compare family members' strengths side by side

description: Side-by-side view of up to 6 saved people: for each of the 12 life areas (career, money, marriage, health, children ...) whether it is strong, mixed or needs care for each person (Sarvashtakavarga points), and the life chapter and phase each is in now. Use when the user asks how family members differ, who is better placed for something, or wants an overview of the family. Omit profiles to compare the 6 most recently saved. Read-only. Only for people saved on the user's AstroCalc account (needs a free AstroCalc sign-in); birth details typed in the chat work without sign-in in free_kundli, kundli_milan, explain_dasha, full_chart and life_timeline.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: 'en' (English, default) or 'hi' (Hindi).

profiles.description: Names or ids of 2 to 6 saved kundlis.

items.description: A saved kundli on the user's AstroCalc account: its name as listed by my_profiles (e.g. 'Mummy') or its id.

name: compare_family
